Phase 1 pipeline: crop types from frozen foundation models

Long image

A

Answer

Six arms map crop types on all of Estonia 2021 from the same chips, labels and test blocks. Five frozen foundation models feed trained decoders, against a U-Net trained from scratch.

  1. Every arm reads one chip set, draws the same parcels at each label budget K and is scored on the same 1,475 test chips.1
  2. Each frozen encoder runs once per chip set; only the decoders train, 45 epochs at every K.
  3. Six experiments back the main design choices, each varying one factor on one encoder.
  4. First results: frozen TerraMind leads per pixel at K = 100 %, frozen TESSERA v2 at 20 and 5 %.2

Applies toEstonia 2021main workflow kshot45-epoch grid of 16 October 2026one draw and one seed per cell

1. Experimental workflow

Diagram structure
  • Satellite inputs imagery
  • EuroCrops parcels parcels
  • Chip set chips
  • Spatial split split
  • Label budget budget
  • Train decoder train
  • Score test blocks test
  • Encode once encode
  • results.json report
  • budget → train · K % labels
  • chips → split
  • imagery → chips
  • encode → train · cached features
  • parcels → chips · rasterised
  • split → budget · train parcels
  • split → encode · 8 D4 copies
  • test → report
  • train → test · best val loss

Grey is frozen or saved to disk, orange is trained for every K, draw and seed, white is data and evaluation.

  1. EuroCrops parcels ↗

    Estonia 2021 declarations from EuroCrops v11, mapped to 20 crop classes.

  2. Satellite inputs ↗

    Twelve monthly Sentinel-2 L2A and Sentinel-1 RTC composites of 2021, and the AlphaEarth annual embedding.

  3. Chip set ↗

    A fixed 2,240 m grid in EPSG:3035: 7,402 chips, each with a crop mask and a parcel-id raster.

  4. Spatial split ↗

    Whole blocks of 4 × 4 chips with a 1,600 m buffer: 4,898 training, 769 validation and 1,475 test chips.

  5. Label budget ↗

    K = 100, 20 and 5 % of the training parcels of each class, applied when the mask loads.

  6. Encode once ↗

    Each frozen encoder runs once per chip set, training chips in all 8 D4 copies. The U-Net skips this step.

  7. Train decoder ↗

    45 epochs at every K, then the checkpoint of lowest validation loss is tested.

  8. Score test blocks ↗

    Macro-F1 per pixel, the primary metric, and per parcel by majority vote of its pixels.

  9. results.json ↗

    One file per fit with its settings, the drawn parcels and every metric.

Fairness ruleStatus in the main workflow
Same input: identical chips and masks for every armMetOne chip set, EE_2021_rev
Same labels: identical parcels at each K and drawMetThe draw depends on class, K and draw only
Same test: one fixed, spatially separated test setMetThe same 1,475 test chips for every fit
Same effort: equal training for every arm and KPartly45 epochs for all; no tuning trials yet
No leakage: buffer, and no validation labels at low KPartly1,600 m buffer; the checkpoint reads validation labels at every K
Like with like: headline comparisons within a resolution groupOpenGroups declared; the U-Net belongs to neither
Repeated and paired: several draws, the same draws for every armNot yetEvery arm on the same draw, but one draw and one seed

3. Experiments that justify the pipeline

Each experiment varies one factor on one encoder and compares the variants on shared draws and seeds. The relative result backs the decision, so none is rerun on the current arms.

ExperimentResultDecision it backsReport
1. THOR tokens: 160, 80 or 40 m40 m beats 160 m by about 0.05 Macro-F1 at every K, for 16 times the cacheTrade-off160 m kept, for parity with TerraMind and a cache that fitsREPORT.md
2. Rotations: 1, 4 or 8 D4 copies8 copies beat 1, no augmentation, by 0.05 to 0.07; most of it through the checkpointKeptAll 8 copies cachedREPORT.md
3. 12 monthly or 24 half-month frames+0.015, +0.035 and +0.001 for 24 frames, within the seed spread, at twice the costKept12 monthly compositesREPORT.md
4. TESSERA: encoder on composites or store embeddingsEqual in the probe (0.371 against 0.373); 0.068 lower at 5 % in the main workflowTrade-offTESSERA v2 frozen on our composites, without the store's offsetREPORT.md
5. TerraMind on S2, S1 or bothS2 + S1 beats S2 by 0.025 to 0.054 and wins every fit; S1 alone is below S2KeptEvery model reads every sensor it was pretrained onREPORT.md
6. Fine-tuned or frozen encoderTESSERA gains 0.04 to 0.08; the token-grid models about 0.01 in validationKeptEncoders stay frozen; fine-tuning is reported as an insightREPORT.md

The main workflow's own results on all of Estonia, frozen and fine-tuned, per pixel and per parcel, are in results_estonia/REPORT.md.

Older arms in experiments 1 to 3

Experiments 1 to 3 ran on TerraMind or THOR with Sentinel-2 alone, at 15 epochs. The frozen token-grid arms gave the same cells at 15 and 45 epochs in the main workflow.
